title: Deed

origin.publisher: City of Los Angeles, Office of the City Clerk (Council File 10-2450), for the Department of General Services, Asset Management Division
origin.title: Grant Deed, City of Los Angeles to White Picket Fence, Inc., 15241 De Pauw Street, Pacific Palisades (APN 4412-028-906), executed September 23, 2011
origin.clearance_note: The executed original of a grant deed by which the City of Los Angeles sold surplus property at auction, filed in Council File 10-2450 on the City Clerk's Council File Management System, the official public record of the council file. Pages 1-5 of the 13-page filing are kept: the deed, its Exhibit A legal description, the signature cover, the execution page and the notary acknowledgment; pages 6-10 (a second deed) and 11-13 (transmittal letters) were dropped. The parties are a city and a corporation. The people named appear only in an official or professional capacity: the mayor, city clerk, city attorney's deputy, general manager, the licensed surveyor who signed Exhibit A, and the notary. The grantee's mail-to block carries an 'Attn:' contact at the corporation's business address; it was deliberately left in place as a corporate-capacity name. No redaction was needed. Document metadata was cleared. The file was downloaded by script.

notes: The request named no feature page or fields, only suggestions in its notes: grantor, grantee, consideration, documentary transfer tax (county and city) and APN. All of them ground ok on page 1. Five featured fields is the limit, so the city transfer tax line ($4,950.00) is extracted but not featured; the county line stands for the transfer tax declaration. Together they read as the conveyance a title or lending reviewer checks first: who conveys to whom, for how much, the tax declared on it, and which parcel. grantee.name is pinned to its first occurrence, the granting clause, not the mail-to block. The request's optional removal of the grantee's 'Attn:' contact line with redact_scan.py was skipped by the orchestrator's decision: it is a name in a corporate capacity at a business address, so clearance stays public; it also appears in extract-pro.json inside mail_to.address. The deed is the executed original, not the recorded copy, so recording_info contains null document_number and recording_date fields. Multi-sentence fields (conditions, reservations, the mail-to address) are paraphrased or span several lines and read OFF.
